title: Pinned single-module pullback comparison map
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], choose the shared derived categories [def-pc-derived-category], and let $M$ be any $\mathcal O_Y$-module. Use exactly the additive structure $a_f$ and left-derived counit $\varepsilon_f$ selected from the composition data of [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition] for $Lf^*$ [def-pc-derived-pullback]; denote that additive structure by canonicalTensorPullbackAdditive. Write $P_f$ for the tensor-pullback functor in [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction] and $f^*_{\mathrm{ord}}$ for Mathlib's ordinary module pullback, also left adjoint to module pushforward. Let $t_f:P_f\xrightarrow{\sim}f^*_{\mathrm{ord}}$ be the unique comparison preserving the tensor-pullback adjunction of [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction] and the ordinary pullback/pushforward adjunction. Define canonicalSinglePullbackMap to be the composite $Lf^*(M[0])\xrightarrow{\varepsilon_{f,M[0]}}Q(P_f(M[0]))\xrightarrow{\sim}(P_fM)[0]\xrightarrow{t_{f,M}[0]}(f^*_{\mathrm{ord}}M)[0]$, where the middle arrow is the localized termwise single-complex identification. This is a morphism for every $M$; no flatness or invertibility of $M$ or $f$ is imposed. Here $Q$ denotes localization from the homotopy category of module complexes to the derived category.

def canonicalSinglePullbackMap {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (M : Y.Modules) :
    (AlgebraicGeometry.derivedPullback f).obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj M) ⟶
    (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj ((pullback f).obj M)
